title: Lookups show active LOG lines beside facts as evidence, never as coverage
goal: rag.py pack, show and audit and the kb MCP tools print the active LOG lines of the matched articles' contexts with their observed dates, labelled as observed signal; coverage and the check line ignore them; a LOG line is never the answer alone.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?
Which LOG row contexts tie a row to a lookup, and how many lines print? The goal leaves both open.
options: as a decision: article, domain, fact, source or a [LOG id] cite in a printed fact; item: alone never; at most 2 lines in pack and show, 20 in audit; none on a none that routes web
also item: contexts of the question's own backlog items
